partially_covered.missing: Organization class only has address and identifier; lacks properties for contact info, legal form, etc.
Item class lacks properties for description, unit, and item type; only net price and quantity are modeled.
Invoice details are spread across header, detail, and summary sections; no consolidated class or property.
InvoiceAmount class exists but lacks currency or breakdown (e.g., gross vs net).
ValidationConstraint class exists, but mandatory identifiers/file format requirements are not enumerated or formally modeled.
BusinessProcess class is present, but lacks taxonomy or process type hierarchy.

cq_coverage.details: Coverage is unchanged from previous iteration. Most CQs are answered, but gaps remain in organization/item granularity, invoice detail consolidation, validation requirements, and business process taxonomy.

strengths: Deep class hierarchy with clear subclassing
Good use of property restrictions and equivalence axioms
weaknesses: No GCAs for complex multi-entity relationships
Disjointness only covers a few key classes; more could be added
Limited granularity in certain classes (e.g., Item, Organization)

reasoner_risks: Hermit and Pellet may flag incomplete coverage for mandatory validation constraints

suggestions_ignored: Expand Item and Organization classes with additional properties (CQ5, CQ8)
Enumerate mandatory identifiers and file format requirements in ValidationConstraint (CQ13)
Introduce GCAs for multi-party relationships and validation constraints
Add additional disjointness axioms for sibling roles, sections, and segments
Develop taxonomies for BusinessProcess and Item
improvement_tracking.notes: None of the previous review's high or medium priority suggestions were implemented. Ontology remains structurally strong and compliant, but fails to improve CQ coverage or quality depth.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand Organization and Item classes with properties for contact info, legal form, item description, unit, and type to fully answer CQ5 and CQ8.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables richer queries about organizations and items, improving CQ coverage.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Enumerate mandatory identifiers and file format requirements within ValidationConstraint or as a dedicated class to address CQ13.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Supports automated validation and compliance checks.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce GCAs for complex multi-role relationships and validation constraints (e.g., all buyers must have a GLN).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves semantic richness and validation reliability.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add disjointness axioms for sibling roles, sections, and segments.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Reduces reasoning ambiguities and improves ontology clarity.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Develop taxonomies for BusinessProcess and Item classes for more granular queries (CQ14, CQ8).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Supports detailed business process and item queries.

summary: The ontology remains robust and OWL 2 compliant, with strong structure and annotation. However, none of the previously suggested improvements were implemented, leaving CQ coverage and quality unchanged. To achieve full coverage and richer modeling, further development is needed on organizational/item details, validation constraints, GCAs, and taxonomies.
